prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Hearts of Iron IV inline stockpile-cost texticon, one static frame, exact final canvas 30x12 pixels; displayed directly beside a numeric prepared-chemical-payload cost.
Input images: Image 1 is a canonical Vanilla HOI4 modifier-family style reference only. Transfer only the restrained aged-material rendering, compact painted shading, and dark edge treatment. Do not copy its supply-can silhouette, geometry, colors, arrangement, or markings.
Primary request: Create one original military inventory glyph for prepared chemical payload stock. It must read as a sealed chemical-warfare payload canister, not fuel or generic support equipment.
Scene/backdrop: No scene or floor. The unused canvas must be genuinely transparent.
Subject: One squat horizontal pressure canister with a clear sealed cap or valve and one small restrained chemical-hazard cue painted directly on its casing. Keep the silhouette distinct from a jerrycan and from a missile.
Style/medium: Compact painted 2D inventory art with modest 1930s–1940s military materials, muted olive-drab and gunmetal, a small desaturated ochre hazard marking, restrained highlights, and a crisp dark outline or subtle shadow.
Composition/framing: Center one broad, horizontal object. Design its visible silhouette for a 30x12 inline glyph: about 2.4:1 width-to-height, simple readable outer shape, complete inset edges, and enough transparent margin to avoid clipping. On the source canvas, use a centered horizontal strip with the glyph spanning most of the width and roughly one third of the height.
Lighting/mood: Even understated icon lighting; small metallic highlights only.
Constraints: Genuine transparent background from the first render; no text, letters, numbers, watermark, fumes, extra objects, scene, tile, frame, border, badge, medallion, or separate emblem. The hazard cue is a small marking on the canister itself. Keep one subject only and do not reproduce Image 1. Optimize the silhouette for readability after smooth downsampling to 30x12.
Avoid: Fuel-container resemblance, long missile silhouette, bright neon colors, chrome shine, modern equipment, cinematic lighting, fake checkerboard, opaque matte, colored halo, unintended transparent holes.
